# COV001: untested-public-function

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| family | COV |
| product | frob |
| severity (default) | warn |
| tier | universal |
| scope | repo |
| fix | manual |
| version | 1 |
| since | 2.0.0 |

A public function or method has no test that reaches it.

The symbol graph's `public_api` lists the function; a test (a function the
`frob-tests` catalog recognises) reaches it when the call graph, or the
unique-name call scan of `frob-tests`, links the test to it, or when a
`frob:tests` directive names the pair. Trait-impl members and items in test
files are not checked. Add a test, or bind an existing one with
`frob:tests <test>` above the function.

## Examples

### COV001 public functions no test reaches / Fires on an untested public function #1 (line 6) (fire)

<!-- frob:waive DOC004 reason="generated example copied from the rule's test corpus" -->
```rust
/// Doubles.
pub fn double(x: i32) -> i32 { x * 2 } // warn: COV001
```

### COV001 public functions no test reaches / Clean when a test calls it, even inside a macro #3 (line 25) (clean)

<!-- frob:waive DOC004 reason="generated example copied from the rule's test corpus" -->
```rust
/// Doubles.
pub fn double(x: i32) -> i32 { x * 2 }

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn doubles() { assert_eq!(double(2), 4); }
}
```

<!-- frob:waive DOC004 reason="generated example copied from the rule's test corpus" -->

fn helper() -> i32 { 1 }
